name: Zenith Coffee Co.
description: Zenith Coffee Co. is a specialty coffee brand dedicated to elevating the everyday coffee experience through sustainably sourced, meticulously roasted, and beautifully packaged beans.
mission: To elevate everyday moments through exceptional coffee experiences while empowering the farmers who make it possible.
vision: Become the go-to premium coffee brand for conscious millennials and Gen-Z, defining the future of transparent and sustainable coffee culture.
unique_selling_points: Farm-to-cup traceability via QR codes on every bag
Direct trade partnerships paying 2x Fair Trade minimums
Exclusive microlot releases curated by world-champion roasters

brand_voice.tone: Knowledgeable but accessible, warm, passionate, and slightly poetic.

visual_identity.typography: Modern Serif for headers (e.g., Playfair Display), Clean Sans-Serif for body (e.g., Inter)
visual_identity.photography_style: High contrast, natural lighting, focus on textures, lifestyle shots integrating nature and modern interiors.
